designations: The Open Group Base Specifications Issue 8
editions.designation_note: One text under three covers. IEEE's page for 1003.1-2024 (standards.ieee.org, read 2026-11-13) says it is simultaneously IEEE Std 1003.1-2024 and The Open Group Base Specifications Issue 8, and lists the ISO/IEC/IEEE 9945 International Standard with the same Issue 8 title. ISO/IEC/IEEE 9945:2026 (edition 2, 2026-03, replacing the 2009 first edition) is known from search-result snippets and from IEEE's own ISO/IEC/IEEE 9945 page (standards.ieee.org/ieee/9945/12489, Active, published 2026-03-24, read 2026-11-13 via a page summariser); iso.org answered HTTP 403 to an automated fetch, so its identity with this HTML is not verified from ISO. It is sold; this collection neither holds nor imports it.
